general.allowed_tables: # One table name per line. Lines starting with # are ignored. # Only the tables listed here can be read. While this list is empty, every query is refused. # See the field comment in the admin for a starter list you can paste and trim.
general.extra_denied_tables: # One table name per line. Lines starting with # are ignored. # Listed tables are protected on top of the allowlist and can never be read.
general.table_acl_map: # One table:resource per line. Lines starting with # are ignored. # Each line names the admin ACL resource a caller must hold to read that table, e.g. # sales_order:Magento_Sales::sales_order # A table with no line here is refused — the tool cannot tell who may read it.
